### A Battle Plan for the Weary
Author: Meredith Houston Carr
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-february-6-2023.html
Passage: 2 Chronicles 20:12
Points:
- Ongoing struggles, such as marital conflict or prolonged trials, can leave believers feeling entirely exhausted and powerless.
- King Jehoshaphat demonstrated how to respond to overwhelming circumstances by openly admitting his own weakness.
- Believers should approach God through honest, vulnerable prayer when weariness sets in.
- Choosing to worship and praise God in the middle of fear and uncertainty is an active step of faith.
- Trusting the Lord's guidance and moving forward in obedience allows God to provide strength and fight our battles.

### What to Do When You Don't Know What to Do
Author: Jeff Schreve
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/fromhisheart/from-his-heart-week-of-september-21.html
Passage: 2 Chronicles 20:12
Points:
- Difficult circumstances such as health, marital, or financial crises can leave us with no human solutions.
- Rather than becoming paralyzed by fear, we can use it as fuel to cry out earnestly to God.
- Believers should lay their needs honestly before the Lord and leave those burdens in His hands.
- Shifting our focus away from the size of the trial and fixing our eyes on God restores faith.
- Praising God in the midst of trouble welcomes His power and intervention into the situation.
